decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass packaging substrates build directly on the firm's long glass processing and patterning know-how, and in-house R&D and EU research projects give it the absorptive capacity to learn from early results and refine this flagship line.

Laser-based through-glass via structuring extends the firm's established glass microstructuring expertise into a growing semiconductor packaging market, and the firm's own R&D lets it assimilate the technology and improve this recently launched flagship.
